verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which "works across multiple AI tools". A hands-on probe confirms the repo's skills are plain, spec-conformant SKILL.md folders that external tooling can install. However, every first-party install instruction targets only Claude Code (plugin marketplace) or the Claude API, and the probe itself ran with the claude-code target only. Missing for 10: documented per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other agents; any evidence of the collection actually installed and working in a non-Claude harness; independent corroboration of cross-agent portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions
